question: Should OpenClaw expose `referenceContext` and the `reference-context` capability as public plugin SDK surface now, make it explicitly experimental, or keep only a narrower internal Codex projection until the cross-host contract is designed?
rationale: The code path is technically plausible, but this is a public plugin API and prompt-authority/security contract that automation cannot bless without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR for now, keep the linked issue canonical, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR once the API direction is chosen.

options.title: Sponsor experimental SDK lane
options.body: A maintainer can ask for explicit experimental wording, docs, and upgrade expectations before merge.

options.title: Sponsor stable SDK lane
options.body: A maintainer can accept the compatibility and security-boundary commitment and proceed with this public SDK shape after final review.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR for now, keep the linked issue canonical, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR once the API direction is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: The central choice is the context-engine API contract and authority semantics, and history plus CONTRIBUTING point most strongly to jalehman for this surface.
